caption: The drawing depicts a single, large ceramic jar with a cylindrical shape and a slightly flared rim. The jar has a brown, earthenware color with shading to indicate its rounded form and give a sense of depth. Around the upper portion of the jar, just below the rim, there is a decorative band featuring blue painted scallop shapes and small dotted patterns. Part of the blue decoration appears irregular or partially smudged. Below this band, the word "COMMERAW'S" is inscribed horizontally on the jar's surface in blue lettering. The background is plain and light with no additional objects or elements, placing full focus on the jar itself. At the lower right corner of the image, the artist's signature, "J. Tarantino," is visible.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
